blocks.en: Introduction and Glossary (Sections 1.0 - 2.0)

blocks.zh: 本章學習目標
blocks.en: Learning Objectives

blocks.zh: 理解 Process Validation (製程確效) 生命週期方法的核心理念及其監管背景
blocks.en: Understand the core philosophy of the Process Validation lifecycle approach and its regulatory background

blocks.zh: 掌握 FDA 三階段製程確效框架 (Stage 1 - Process Design, Stage 2 - Process Qualification, Stage 3 - Continued Process Verification) 的基本架構
blocks.en: Master the basic structure of the FDA three-stage process validation framework (Stage 1 - Process Design, Stage 2 - Process Qualification, Stage 3 - Continued Process Verification)

blocks.zh: 了解 TR60 的適用範圍：涵蓋哪些產品類別、排除哪些類別
blocks.en: Understand the scope of TR60: which product categories are covered and which are excluded

blocks.zh: 認識 ICH 品質指引 (Q8, Q9, Q10, Q12, Q13, Q14) 與 PV 生命週期的關聯
blocks.en: Recognize how the ICH quality guidelines (Q8, Q9, Q10, Q12, Q13, Q14) relate to the PV lifecycle

blocks.zh: 區分 Continuous Process Verification (持續製程驗證) 與 Continued Process Verification (持續製程確認) 的差異
blocks.en: Distinguish Continuous Process Verification from Continued Process Verification

blocks.zh: 熟悉 TR60 中使用的關鍵術語及其定義
blocks.en: Become familiar with the key terms used in TR60 and their definitions

blocks.zh: 本節目錄 Section Contents
blocks.en: Section Contents

blocks.zh: 1.0 Introduction 導論
blocks.en: 1.0 Introduction

blocks.zh: 原文內容 Original Text
blocks.en: Original Text

blocks.zh: 導師解析 Tutorial Commentary
blocks.en: Tutorial Commentary

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 Key Concepts
blocks.en: Key Concepts

blocks.zh: Process Validation, PV (製程確效)：透過科學證據證明一個製造過程能持續生產出符合預定品質標準的產品。FDA 和 EMA 都將其視為藥品品質保證中不可或缺的要素。
blocks.en: Process Validation, PV: Providing scientific evidence that a manufacturing process consistently produces product that meets its predetermined quality standards. Both FDA and EMA regard it as an indispensable element of drug quality assurance.

blocks.zh: PV Lifecycle Concept (PV 生命週期概念)：將產品從開發到商業化生產再到上市後維護，視為一個完整、協調的整體過程，而非一次性的測試事件。
blocks.en: PV Lifecycle Concept: Treating a product, from development through commercial manufacturing to post-marketing maintenance, as one complete, coordinated process rather than a one-time testing event.

blocks.zh: Quality Risk Management, QRM (品質風險管理)：系統性地識別、評估和控制可能影響產品品質的風險因子。
blocks.en: Quality Risk Management, QRM: Systematically identifying, assessing, and controlling risk factors that may affect product quality.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 Analogy
blocks.en: Analogy

blocks.zh: 想像你開一家連鎖餐廳。製程確效就像確保每家分店都能穩定做出相同品質的料理。這不只是開幕前試做幾次就好（傳統方式），而是從研發菜單（Stage 1）、到正式營運前的驗收測試（Stage 2）、再到營運後的持續品質監控（Stage 3），形成一個完整的品質保證循環。
blocks.en: Imagine you run a restaurant chain. Process validation is like making sure every branch consistently turns out dishes of the same quality. It is not enough to cook a few trial dishes before opening (the traditional approach). Instead, it runs from developing the menu (Stage 1), to the acceptance test before formal operation (Stage 2), to ongoing quality monitoring once the restaurant is open (Stage 3), forming one complete quality assurance cycle.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 Key Notes
blocks.en: Key Notes

blocks.zh: TR60 開篇就強調：PV 生命週期方法「可能不是線性或循序的」(may not be linear or sequential)。這是一個非常重要的觀點 -- 當新的產品/製程知識出現時，可以在製程的任何部分啟動變更。這與傳統「先做完開發，再做確效，最後維護」的線性思維截然不同。
blocks.en: TR60 stresses from the outset that the PV lifecycle approach "may not be linear or sequential". This is a very important point: when new product/process knowledge emerges, changes can be initiated in any part of the process. This is very different from the traditional linear thinking of "finish development first, then validate, then maintain".

blocks.zh: 1.1 Purpose and Scope 目的與範圍
blocks.en: 1.1 Purpose and Scope

blocks.zh: Drug Substance, DS (原料藥)：在藥品製造中使用的活性成分物質，後續會與賦形劑配製成最終藥品。
blocks.en: Drug Substance, DS: The active ingredient used in drug manufacturing, which is later formulated with excipients into the final drug product.

blocks.zh: Drug Product, DP (藥品成品)：最終包裝中的劑型產品，即供上市銷售的成品。
blocks.en: Drug Product, DP: The dosage form in its final packaging, i.e., the finished product supplied to the market.

blocks.zh: ATMP (先進治療醫藥產品)：包括基因治療、細胞治療及組織工程產品，是近年藥品開發的前沿領域。
blocks.en: ATMP (Advanced Therapy Medicinal Products): Includes gene therapy, cell therapy, and tissue-engineered products, a frontier area of drug development in recent years.

blocks.zh: RMAT (再生醫學先進治療)：FDA 針對再生醫學產品的特殊加速審查路徑。
blocks.en: RMAT (Regenerative Medicine Advanced Therapy): FDA's special expedited review pathway for regenerative medicine products.

blocks.zh: TR60 的適用範圍非常廣泛，幾乎涵蓋所有藥品類型。特別注意以下重點：
blocks.en: The scope of TR60 is very broad and covers almost all drug types. Pay particular attention to the following points:

blocks.zh: 適用於新產品和既有商業產品的製程
blocks.en: Applies to processes for new products and existing commercial products

blocks.zh: 適用於全球使用場景
blocks.en: Applies to global use scenarios

blocks.zh: 醫療器材「單獨時」不在範圍內，但組合產品中的藥品成分則納入
blocks.en: Medical devices "on their own" are out of scope, but the drug constituent of combination products is included

blocks.zh: 清潔驗證、無菌製程模擬 (APS)、滅菌驗證等輔助操作有各自專屬的 PDA 技術報告
blocks.en: Supporting operations such as cleaning validation, aseptic process simulation (APS), and sterilization validation have their own dedicated PDA technical reports

blocks.zh: TR60 就像一本「烹飪總則」，適用於中餐、西餐、日料、甜點等各種料理類型。但像是「如何正確清洗刀具」（清潔驗證）或「如何消毒砧板」（滅菌驗證）這些專門操作，另有各自的專用手冊。同樣地，膳食補充品（保健食品）和動物飼料有自己的法規體系，不在這本總則的管轄範圍。
blocks.en: TR60 is like a general "cooking handbook" that applies to Chinese, Western, and Japanese cuisine, desserts, and other types of cooking. Specialized operations such as "how to wash knives properly" (cleaning validation) or "how to sanitize a chopping board" (sterilization validation) are covered by their own dedicated manuals. Likewise, dietary supplements (health foods) and animal feed have their own regulatory systems and fall outside the scope of this general handbook.

blocks.zh: 練習思考 Practice Questions
blocks.en: Practice Questions

blocks.zh: 你的公司若同時生產生物製劑和組合產品（藥品+器材），TR60 的指引如何分別適用？
blocks.en: If your company makes both biologics and combination products (drug + device), how does TR60 apply to each?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR60 強調對既有商業產品也適用生命週期方法？這對一家已經生產多年的藥廠意味著什麼？
blocks.en: Why does TR60 stress that the lifecycle approach also applies to existing commercial products? What does this mean for a manufacturer that has been producing for many years?

blocks.zh: ATMP 和傳統小分子藥品的製程確效，在實務上可能有哪些差異？
blocks.en: In practice, how might process validation differ between an ATMP and a conventional small-molecule drug?

blocks.zh: 1.2 Background 背景
blocks.en: 1.2 Background

blocks.zh: 核心概念解析 - ICH 品質指引體系
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The ICH Quality Guideline System

blocks.zh: ICH 品質指引是全球藥品監管的基石。以下是與 PV 最直接相關的指引：
blocks.en: The ICH quality guidelines are the cornerstone of global drug regulation. The following are the guidelines most directly related to PV:

blocks.zh: ICH Q8(R2) (藥品開發)：從開發階段就規劃商業製程的控制策略，強調 Design of Experiments (實驗設計) 和統計分析
blocks.en: ICH Q8(R2) (Pharmaceutical Development): Plans the control strategy for the commercial process from the development stage, emphasizing Design of Experiments and statistical analysis

blocks.zh: ICH Q9(R1) (品質風險管理)：以風險為基礎，識別和優先處理最可能影響產品品質的製程參數和品質屬性
blocks.en: ICH Q9(R1) (Quality Risk Management): Takes a risk-based approach to identify and prioritize the process parameters and quality attributes most likely to affect product quality

blocks.zh: ICH Q10 (藥品品質系統)：將製程設計整合到品質系統中，確保開發到商業化的無縫銜接
blocks.en: ICH Q10 (Pharmaceutical Quality System): Integrates process design into the quality system, ensuring a seamless transition from development to commercialization

blocks.zh: ICH Q12 (產品生命週期管理)：上市後變更的技術和法規考量
blocks.en: ICH Q12 (Product Lifecycle Management): Technical and regulatory considerations for post-approval changes

blocks.zh: ICH Q13 (連續製造)：針對連續製造的新指引
blocks.en: ICH Q13 (Continuous Manufacturing): A new guideline for continuous manufacturing

blocks.zh: ICH Q14 (分析方法開發)：分析方法的生命週期方法
blocks.en: ICH Q14 (Analytical Procedure Development): A lifecycle approach for analytical procedures

blocks.zh: 核心概念 - FDA 三階段框架
blocks.en: Key Concepts - The FDA Three-Stage Framework

blocks.zh: Stage 1: Process Design 製程設計
blocks.en: Stage 1: Process Design

blocks.zh: Stage 2: Process Qualification 製程確認
blocks.en: Stage 2: Process Qualification

blocks.zh: Stage 3: Continued Process Verification (CPV) 持續製程確認
blocks.en: Stage 3: Continued Process Verification (CPV)

blocks.zh: 這三個階段構成了 PV 生命週期的骨幹，後續章節 (3.0, 4.0, 5.0) 將分別深入討論。
blocks.en: These three stages form the backbone of the PV lifecycle; later sections (3.0, 4.0, 5.0) discuss each in depth.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - PVMP 與品質體系
blocks.en: Key Notes - PVMP and the Quality System

blocks.zh: Process Validation Master Plan, PVMP (製程確效主計畫)：描述整體確效理由、驗證策略和具體研究清單的總綱文件，應存放在企業的品質文件系統中。
blocks.en: Process Validation Master Plan, PVMP: The overarching document describing the overall validation rationale, validation strategy, and the list of specific studies. It should be kept in the company's quality document system.

blocks.zh: 成功的確效計畫有三個關鍵特徵：
blocks.en: A successful validation program has three key characteristics:

blocks.zh: 及早啟動 -- 在產品生命週期的早期就開始規劃
blocks.en: Start early -- Begin planning early in the product lifecycle

blocks.zh: 持續更新 -- 透過變更管控在整個生命週期中保持最新
blocks.en: Keep it current -- Keep it up to date throughout the lifecycle through change control

blocks.zh: 跨功能合作 -- Quality Unit 和法規單位從一開始就參與
blocks.en: Cross-functional collaboration -- The Quality Unit and regulatory affairs are involved from the start

blocks.zh: PVMP 就像建築師在動工前繪製的「施工總規劃圖」。它不是一張固定不變的藍圖，而是隨著工程進展（產品生命週期）持續更新的動態文件。就像蓋一棟大樓需要結構工程師、水電師傅、消防安全人員從設計階段就共同參與一樣，PV 也需要品質、法規、製造等跨功能團隊從一開始就協同合作。
blocks.en: The PVMP is like the architect's "master construction plan" drawn before work begins. It is not a fixed blueprint but a dynamic document that is continuously updated as the project (the product lifecycle) progresses. Just as constructing a building requires structural engineers, plumbers and electricians, and fire safety personnel to be involved from the design stage, PV also needs cross-functional teams such as quality, regulatory, and manufacturing to work together from the very beginning.

blocks.zh: 為什麼 ICH Q8 強調在開發階段就要考慮商業製造設備的功能和限制？如果忽略這一點會有什麼後果？
blocks.en: Why does ICH Q8 stress considering the capabilities and limitations of commercial manufacturing equipment already during development? What are the consequences of ignoring this?

blocks.zh: 假設你是一個 CDMO 的品質主管，如何向客戶解釯 "enhanced PV approach" 與 "traditional PV" 的差異和優勢？
blocks.en: Suppose you are the quality head at a CDMO. How would you explain to a client the differences between, and the advantages of, an "enhanced PV approach" versus "traditional PV"?

blocks.zh: 為什麼即使 Stage 1 的某些研究不要求在 GMP 下執行，仍建議品質和法規人員參與？
blocks.en: Why is it still recommended that quality and regulatory personnel take part even though some Stage 1 studies are not required to be performed under GMP?

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - Continuous vs. Continued
blocks.en: Key Notes - Continuous vs. Continued

blocks.zh: 這兩個易混淆的術語必須區分清楚：
blocks.en: These two easily confused terms must be clearly distinguished:

blocks.zh: 1.2.1 Review of Guidances Issued after Technical Report No. 60 First Published in 2013 1.2.1 Technical Report No. 60 於 2013 年首次發布後所發行指引的回顧
blocks.en: 1.2.1 Review of Guidances Issued after Technical Report No. 60 First Published in 2013

blocks.zh: 核心概念 - 全球監管地圖
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Global Regulatory Map

blocks.zh: 製程確效不是單一國家的要求，而是全球監管的共識。以下是主要的監管機構和指引來源：
blocks.en: Process validation is not the requirement of a single country but a global regulatory consensus. The main regulatory bodies and sources of guidance are:

blocks.zh: ICH：國際協調組織，制定全球通用的品質指引
blocks.en: ICH: The International Council for Harmonisation, which develops globally applicable quality guidelines

blocks.zh: FDA：美國食品藥物管理局
blocks.en: FDA: The US Food and Drug Administration

blocks.zh: EMA：歐洲藥品管理局
blocks.en: EMA: The European Medicines Agency

blocks.zh: PIC/S：藥品稽查合作計畫，建立 GMP 稽查的國際一致標準
blocks.en: PIC/S: The Pharmaceutical Inspection Co-operation Scheme, which establishes internationally consistent standards for GMP inspections

blocks.zh: WHO：世界衛生組織
blocks.en: WHO: The World Health Organization

blocks.zh: PMDA（日本）、NMPA（中國）、KFDA（韓國）、TGA（澳洲）、Health Canada（加拿大）、ANVISA（巴西）等區域性機構
blocks.en: Regional agencies such as PMDA (Japan), NMPA (China), KFDA (Korea), TGA (Australia), Health Canada (Canada), and ANVISA (Brazil)

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - 2013年後的關鍵法規更新
blocks.en: Key Notes - Key Regulatory Updates after 2013

blocks.zh: TR60 修訂版特別關注 2013 年初版之後發布的指引。以下是最具影響力的文件：
blocks.en: The revised TR60 pays particular attention to guidance issued after the original 2013 edition. The most influential documents are:

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022 修訂)：無菌藥品製造的全面更新，對無菌製程確效有深遠影響
blocks.en: EU Annex 1 (2022 revision): A comprehensive update on sterile medicinal product manufacturing, with far-reaching impact on aseptic process validation

blocks.zh: EU Annex 15：歐盟 GMP 中最直接涉及確認與確效的附錄
blocks.en: EU Annex 15: The annex of EU GMP that deals most directly with qualification and validation

blocks.zh: ICH Q12：為上市後變更管理提供了框架，與 Stage 3 CPV 密切相關
blocks.en: ICH Q12: Provides a framework for post-approval change management, closely related to Stage 3 CPV

blocks.zh: ICH Q13：連續製造的出現帶來全新的確效挑戰
blocks.en: ICH Q13: The emergence of continuous manufacturing brings entirely new validation challenges

blocks.zh: ICH Q14：將生命週期方法延伸到分析方法開發
blocks.en: ICH Q14: Extends the lifecycle approach to analytical procedure development

blocks.zh: FDA 資料完整性指引：強調確效數據的 ALCOA+ 原則
blocks.en: FDA data integrity guidance: Emphasizes the ALCOA+ principles for validation data

blocks.zh: 全球法規體系就像聯合國的多層架構：ICH 就像聯合國制定國際公約，各國（FDA、EMA、PMDA 等）再根據公約制定自己的國內法。作為一個全球營運的藥廠或 CDMO，你不能只看一個國家的規定，而要了解整個「國際公約」體系。TR60 就是將這些分散的指引整合成一份實用的參考文件。
blocks.en: The global regulatory system is like the multi-layered structure of the United Nations: ICH is like the UN drawing up international conventions, and each country (FDA, EMA, PMDA, etc.) then writes its own domestic law based on them. As a manufacturer or CDMO operating globally, you cannot look at only one country's rules; you need to understand the whole "international convention" system. TR60 integrates these scattered guidelines into one practical reference document.

blocks.zh: 實務應用 Practical Application
blocks.en: Practical Application

blocks.zh: 作為 CDMO，你可能同時為美國、歐洲和日本市場生產藥品。這意味著你的製程確效計畫必須同時滿足 FDA Guidance、EU Annex 15 和 PMDA 的要求。TR60 的價值在於它整合了這些不同來源的最佳實踐，讓你可以建立一套「一次確效，多國適用」的策略。
blocks.en: As a CDMO, you may manufacture drugs for the US, European, and Japanese markets at the same time. This means your process validation program must simultaneously satisfy FDA Guidance, EU Annex 15, and PMDA requirements. The value of TR60 is that it consolidates best practices from these different sources, letting you build a "validate once, apply in many countries" strategy.

blocks.zh: EU Annex 1 (2022) 的修訂對無菌產品的製程確效帶來了哪些新要求？
blocks.en: What new requirements does the revision of EU Annex 1 (2022) bring for process validation of sterile products?

blocks.zh: ICH Q13 針對連續製造提出了哪些獨特的確效挑戰？與傳統批次製造有何不同？
blocks.en: What unique validation challenges does ICH Q13 raise for continuous manufacturing? How do they differ from traditional batch manufacturing?

blocks.zh: 2.0 Glossary 術語表
blocks.en: 2.0 Glossary

blocks.zh: 核心概念 - 術語層級關係
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Hierarchy of Terms

blocks.zh: TR60 的術語表不只是字典，它反映了製程確效的核心邏輯架構。讓我們按照邏輯關係來理解這些術語：
blocks.en: The TR60 glossary is more than a dictionary; it reflects the core logical structure of process validation. Let us understand the terms according to their logical relationships:

blocks.zh: 品質屬性的層級：
blocks.en: Hierarchy of quality attributes:

blocks.zh: Attribute (屬性)：輸入或輸出物料的物理、化學或微生物特性 -- 最廣泛的概念
blocks.en: Attribute: A physical, chemical, or microbiological property of an input or output material -- the broadest concept

blocks.zh: Quality Attribute (品質屬性)：被選定用於指示產品品質的分子或產品特性 -- 所有與品質有關的屬性
blocks.en: Quality Attribute: A molecular or product characteristic selected to indicate product quality -- all attributes related to quality

blocks.zh: Critical Quality Attribute, CQA (關鍵品質屬性)：必須在適當的限度、範圍或分佈內以確保所需產品品質的屬性 -- 最關鍵的子集
blocks.en: Critical Quality Attribute, CQA: An attribute that must be within an appropriate limit, range, or distribution to ensure the desired product quality -- the most critical subset

blocks.zh: 核心概念 - 製程參數的分類
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Classification of Process Parameters

blocks.zh: 製程參數的層級：
blocks.en: Hierarchy of process parameters:

blocks.zh: Process Parameter (製程參數)：可以直接控制的製造過程輸入變數或條件（如溫度、時間、流速）
blocks.en: Process Parameter: An input variable or condition of the manufacturing process that can be directly controlled (e.g., temperature, time, flow rate)

blocks.zh: Critical Process Parameter, CPP (關鍵製程參數)：其變異性會影響 CQA 的製程參數，因此必須監控或控制
blocks.en: Critical Process Parameter, CPP: A process parameter whose variability affects a CQA and therefore must be monitored or controlled

blocks.zh: Noncritical Process Parameter (非關鍵製程參數)：在該製程步驟中對品質無影響的參數，但可能影響下一步驟的性能
blocks.en: Noncritical Process Parameter: A parameter with no impact on quality at that process step, but which may affect the performance of the next step

blocks.zh: 操作範圍的層級：
blocks.en: Hierarchy of operating ranges:

blocks.zh: Design Space (設計空間)：已被證明能確保品質的多維度輸入變數和製程參數的組合 -- 最外層
blocks.en: Design Space: The multidimensional combination of input variables and process parameters demonstrated to assure quality -- the outermost layer

blocks.zh: Proven Acceptable Range, PAR (已證明可接受範圍)：已被驗證為可接受的參數範圍 -- 中間層
blocks.en: Proven Acceptable Range, PAR: The parameter range that has been demonstrated to be acceptable -- the middle layer

blocks.zh: Normal Operating Range, NOR (正常操作範圍)：製造指令中指定的目標和範圍 -- 最內層，日常操作的實際目標
blocks.en: Normal Operating Range, NOR: The target and range specified in the manufacturing instructions -- the innermost layer, the actual target for daily operation

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 - Design Space vs NOR vs PAR
blocks.en: Analogy - Design Space vs NOR vs PAR

blocks.zh: 想像你開車在高速公路上：
blocks.en: Imagine you are driving on a highway:

blocks.zh: Design Space = 整條道路的邊界護欄，超出就「出事」（品質風險）
blocks.en: Design Space = the guardrails at the edges of the whole road; go beyond them and you "crash" (quality risk)

blocks.zh: PAR (已證明可接受範圍) = 車道標線，在標線內行駛已被證明是安全的
blocks.en: PAR (Proven Acceptable Range) = the lane markings; driving within the markings has been proven safe

blocks.zh: NOR (正常操作範圍) = 你的方向盤實際瞄準的車道中心位置，日常操作的目標
blocks.en: NOR (Normal Operating Range) = the center of the lane your steering wheel actually aims for, the target of daily operation

blocks.zh: 重要的是：在 Design Space 內操作不算「變更」，但超出 Design Space 就是變更，需要啟動法規上市後變更程序。
blocks.en: The important point: operating within the Design Space is not a "change", but moving outside the Design Space is a change and requires initiating the regulatory post-approval change procedure.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - CpK vs PpK 的區別
blocks.en: Key Notes - CpK vs PpK

blocks.zh: 這兩個統計指標經常被混淆，但它們有重要區別：
blocks.en: These two statistical indices are often confused, but there are important differences between them:

blocks.zh: CpK (製程能力指數)：衡量製程在「穩定狀態」下的固有能力，使用組內變異計算。代表製程的「最佳情境」表現。
blocks.en: CpK (Process Capability Index): Measures the inherent capability of the process in a "stable state", calculated using within-subgroup variation. It represents the process's "best-case" performance.

blocks.zh: PpK (製程績效指數)：衡量製程的「實際表現」，使用總變異（包含組內和組間變異）計算。反映製程的真實績效。
blocks.en: PpK (Process Performance Index): Measures the "actual performance" of the process, calculated using total variation (both within-subgroup and between-subgroup variation). It reflects the process's true performance.

blocks.zh: 實務判斷：若 CpK >> PpK，表示製程存在顯著的批次間變異（特殊原因變異），需要調查。
blocks.en: Practical judgment: if CpK >> PpK, the process has significant batch-to-batch variation (special-cause variation) that needs to be investigated.

blocks.zh: 核心概念 - 其他重要術語
blocks.en: Key Concepts - Other Important Terms

blocks.zh: Control Strategy (控制策略)：基於當前產品和製程理解所規劃的一組控制措施，包含參數控制、物料屬性、設施設備條件、製程中管控、成品規格等。這是整個 PV 生命週期的核心產出之一。
blocks.en: Control Strategy: A planned set of controls, derived from current product and process understanding, that includes parameter controls, material attributes, facility and equipment conditions, in-process controls, finished product specifications, and so on. It is one of the core outputs of the entire PV lifecycle.

blocks.zh: Data Integrity (資料完整性)：確保資料在整個生命週期中保持完整、一致、準確、可信和可靠。TR60 (2026修訂版) 特別提到了「AI 驅動洞察的有效性」，反映了數位化轉型的趨勢。
blocks.en: Data Integrity: Ensuring that data remain complete, consistent, accurate, trustworthy, and reliable throughout the data lifecycle. TR60 (2026 revision) specifically mentions "the validity of AI-driven insights", reflecting the trend of digital transformation.

blocks.zh: Knowledge Management, KM (知識管理)：系統性地獲取、分析、儲存和傳播與產品、製程和組件相關的資訊。知識來源包括先驗知識、開發研究、技術轉移、確效研究、製造經驗等。
blocks.en: Knowledge Management, KM: A systematic approach to acquiring, analyzing, storing, and disseminating information related to products, manufacturing processes, and components. Sources of knowledge include prior knowledge, development studies, technology transfer, validation studies, manufacturing experience, and so on.

blocks.zh: Platform Manufacturing (平台製造)：從同一製造商已用於生產同類藥品的類似製程出發，為新藥開發生產策略。這對 CDMO 特別重要，可大幅縮短開發時間。
blocks.en: Platform Manufacturing: Developing a manufacturing strategy for a new drug by starting from similar processes the same manufacturer has already used to make similar drugs. This is especially important for CDMOs, as it can greatly shorten development time.

blocks.zh: 比喻說明 - Platform Manufacturing
blocks.en: Analogy - Platform Manufacturing

blocks.zh: Platform Manufacturing 就像汽車製造商的「共用底盤平台」策略。Toyota 的 TNGA 平台可以衍生出 Camry、RAV4、Lexus ES 等不同車型。同樣地，一個生物製藥 CDMO 的單株抗體生產平台可以快速適配不同客戶的 mAb 產品，只需調整少數特定參數，大幅縮短開發和確效時間。
blocks.en: Platform manufacturing is like a carmaker's "shared chassis platform" strategy. Toyota's TNGA platform can yield different models such as the Camry, RAV4, and Lexus ES. Similarly, a biopharmaceutical CDMO's monoclonal antibody production platform can be quickly adapted to different clients' mAb products by adjusting only a few specific parameters, greatly shortening development and validation time.

blocks.zh: 重點提示 - PAT 與 Enhanced Approach
blocks.en: Key Notes - PAT and the Enhanced Approach

blocks.zh: Process Analytical Technology, PAT (製程分析技術)：透過即時量測（在製程進行中）來設計、分析和控制製造的系統。PAT 是實現 enhanced approach（增強方法）和 continuous process verification（持續製程驗證）的技術基礎。
blocks.en: Process Analytical Technology, PAT: A system for designing, analyzing, and controlling manufacturing through real-time measurements (during processing). PAT is the technical foundation for realizing the enhanced approach and continuous process verification.

blocks.zh: PAT 的實際應用範例：
blocks.en: Practical examples of PAT:

blocks.zh: 近紅外光譜 (NIR) 即時監測混合均勻度
blocks.en: Near-infrared spectroscopy (NIR) for real-time monitoring of blend uniformity

blocks.zh: 拉曼光譜即時監測結晶過程
blocks.en: Raman spectroscopy for real-time monitoring of the crystallization process

blocks.zh: 多變量資料分析 (MVDA) 即時預測 CQA
blocks.en: Multivariate data analysis (MVDA) for real-time prediction of CQAs

blocks.zh: 如果一個製程參數被歸類為 CPP，這對你的確效策略（取樣計畫、監控頻率）有什麼具體影響？
blocks.en: If a process parameter is classified as a CPP, what specific impact does this have on your validation strategy (sampling plan, monitoring frequency)?

blocks.zh: Design Space 內的操作不算「變更」，這對法規申報有什麼實際優勢？為什麼監管機構要求 Design Space 需經核准？
blocks.en: Operating within the Design Space is not a "change". What practical advantage does this offer for regulatory filings? Why do regulators require the Design Space to be approved?

blocks.zh: CpK = 1.33 而 PpK = 0.8 的情況代表什麼？你會建議採取什麼行動？
blocks.en: What does it mean when CpK = 1.33 and PpK = 0.8? What action would you recommend?

blocks.zh: 為什麼 TR60 (2026修訂版) 在 Data Integrity 定義中特別提到 AI？這反映了產業的什麼趨勢？
blocks.en: Why does TR60 (2026 revision) specifically mention AI in the definition of Data Integrity? What industry trend does this reflect?

blocks.zh: 本節重點回顧 Section Summary
blocks.en: Section Summary

blocks.zh: PV 是生命週期活動：製程確效不是一次性事件，而是貫穿產品從開發到停產整個生命週期的持續活動
blocks.en: PV is a lifecycle activity: Process validation is not a one-time event but an ongoing activity spanning the entire product lifecycle from development to discontinuation

blocks.zh: FDA 三階段框架：Stage 1 (Process Design) → Stage 2 (Process Qualification) → Stage 3 (Continued Process Verification)，構成 PV 生命週期的骨幹
blocks.en: FDA three-stage framework: Stage 1 (Process Design) → Stage 2 (Process Qualification) → Stage 3 (Continued Process Verification), forming the backbone of the PV lifecycle

blocks.zh: 全球適用：TR60 整合了 ICH、FDA、EMA 等全球主要監管機構的指引，適用於幾乎所有藥品類型
blocks.en: Global applicability: TR60 integrates guidance from major regulators worldwide, including ICH, FDA, and EMA, and applies to almost all drug types

blocks.zh: Continuous vs. Continued：Continuous Process Verification 是使用 PAT 等先進技術的驗證替代方法；Continued Process Verification (CPV) 是確保常規生產維持受控狀態的 Stage 3 活動
blocks.en: Continuous vs. Continued: Continuous Process Verification is an alternative validation approach using advanced technologies such as PAT; Continued Process Verification (CPV) is the Stage 3 activity that ensures routine production remains in a state of control

blocks.zh: 關鍵術語關係：Attribute → Quality Attribute → CQA 形成品質屬性的層級；Process Parameter → CPP 形成參數的關鍵性分類；Design Space → PAR → NOR 形成操作範圍的嵌套結構
blocks.en: Relationships among key terms: Attribute → Quality Attribute → CQA form a hierarchy of quality attributes; Process Parameter → CPP forms the criticality classification of parameters; Design Space → PAR → NOR form a nested structure of operating ranges

blocks.zh: 跨功能協作：品質單位、法規單位應從 PV 研究設計之初就參與，確保與品質系統和法規期望相容
blocks.en: Cross-functional collaboration: The quality unit and regulatory affairs should be involved from the very start of PV study design to ensure compatibility with the quality system and regulatory expectations

blocks.zh: PVMP 是基石：製程確效主計畫應描述整體理由、確效策略和具體研究清單，並透過變更管控持續更新
blocks.en: The PVMP is the cornerstone: The process validation master plan should describe the overall rationale, validation strategy, and list of specific studies, and be continuously updated through change control
